d: Deshbhar men kal roshni ka tyohar dipavli manaee jaegi. chhoti dipavli ke avsar par gharon aur bajaron men raunak dekhne ko mil rahi hai. ayodhya dham men bhavy aur divy dipotsav ki taiyariyan puri kar li gaee hain. vahin, parv-tyoharon ke dauran yatriyon ki suvidha aur suraksha ko lekar bhartiy relve ne vishesh taiyari ki hai. rel mantri svayan vyavasthaon ki nigrani kar rahe hain aur unhonne varansi ka daura kar taiyariyon ka jayja liya. jharkhand men bhi chhath mahaparv ko lekar ghaton ki saph-saphaee aur any vyavasthaon par sarkar vishesh jor de rahi hai. idhar, aadivasi netri nisha…
